messages:
Maya (PM): quick sync — I sketched an initiative timeline + handoff checklist in the figjam (link in doc). we need owners & upstream deps filled by EOD Thu so we can lock the roadmap on Fri.
Liam (Eng): quick q — are we still targeting Dedicated GA in week 8? that changes backend capacity and rollout window.
Maya (PM): yes tentatively week 8, but flexible if infra/quant teams call out hard blockers. want product to pick a tradeoff before Friday.
Priya (Platform): Platform note — to meet week 8 we need the final infra config (node types, autoscaling knobs, network egress) by Apr 20. if that misses, +2w on Dedicated readiness.
Jorge (ML): ML/Model team — quantization + perf profiling for 8k seq will take ~3 sprints. blocker: we still don't have perf traces from staging for long contexts (see my comment in the figjam). if we can get traces by Tues we can compress timeline.
Sasha (Design): Design ask — API surface must be locked earlier. suggest we trim to surface A (streaming + simple function-calls) and defer structured outputs v2. reduces frontend work ~1 sprint.
Noah (EngInfra): infra upgrade note — k8s 1.27 upgrade scheduled Apr 5. deployment pipeline automation for Dedicated depends on that. if that slips, we'll need manual cutovers for first rollout.
Liam (Eng): can we flatten a critical sequence? e.g. force GA without pipeline automation but with a manual runbook? what's the risk on SLOs + ops headcount?
Priya (Platform): manual cutover is possible but ops burn goes up x3 for ramp week. also increases incident risk during traffic spikes.
Maya (PM): proposal: lock scope by Fri -> choose Design surface A -> commit to infra config by Apr 20 -> ML to provide perf traces by Tue -> if any item misses, delay GA by 2 weeks. agree / disagree?
Jorge (ML): agree on sequence. i'll prioritize trace capture. adding owner tag in the figjam.
Sasha (Design): agree — i'll publish API spec v1 and a short delta doc for v2.
Liam (Eng): i'll draft a minimal rollout runbook and a checklist for manual cutover + list of required oncall rotations.
Noah (EngInfra): noted. i'll post potential automation blockers in the doc and flag k8s risks.
roadmap-bot: reminder — product roadmap lock deadline: Fri 16:00 PT. please confirm owners in doc before then. :bell:
Maya (PM): thanks — once owners are filled i'll create a sequenced milestone list and share a one-pager for exec review.
Liam (Eng): tagging @Priya @Noah please confirm infra acceptance criteria so I can schedule eng work.
Priya (Platform): ack, will add criteria by EOD Wed.
Maya (PM): perfect. leaving this thread open for updates; i'll run a 15m sync Thu AM if there are open blockers. :calendar:
thread_summary: coordination thread to lock initiative scope + handoffs for upcoming Dedicated/infra launch; owners to add dependencies in figjam, sequence milestones, and confirm accept criteria by deadlines. contingency = +2 weeks if key items slip.
